cash_breakdown.item: Bank balances and cash with original maturity of three months or less
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: 99% of group bank balances/cash are RMB and the report does not split listed parent versus PRC subsidiaries; use Mainland subsidiary/group cash haircut instead of full cash deduction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash and bank deposits are funds assets, but only partly detachable in a control transaction without proof of immediate upstreaming.

cash_breakdown.item: Bank deposits with original maturity over three months
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Bank deposits are financial assets, but exact tenor beyond the over-three-month bucket and parent/subsidiary ownership are not fully disclosed; apply PRC subsidiary and term-deposit haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Can potentially be redeemed or used for debt repayment/dividends, but not treated as fully available cash.

cash_breakdown.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - unquoted fund investment
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Unquoted fund investment; fair value exists but liquidity and exit certainty are weak, so use low end of unlisted investment haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Included as a possible detachable investment asset only at a conservative discount.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Government restricted accounts, bills payable guarantee deposits and performance security deposits are not freely detachable.
Interest-bearing RMB bank borrowings are deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financing debt must be repaid or netted before owner cash can be extracted.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Retain about two months of cash operating costs for a cement manufacturer with annual revenue RMB5.885bn, cash costs around RMB5.2bn after depreciation/amortisation, volatile demand and RMB228.732m capital commitments.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash required to keep production, fuel/power, freight, wages and short-cycle payables operating should not be extracted.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Most cash is RMB and likely held in Mainland operating subsidiaries; use an explicit friction reserve for upstreaming, exchange and transaction leakage after asset haircuts.
cash_breakdown.reason: Deducted from owner-extractable net cash because the report does not prove frictionless movement to the listed holder.

profit_quality.assessment: Use a conservative positive denominator rather than the latest loss alone: the 2022-2024 parent-profit median is RMB106.088m, but 2024 turned to a RMB263.682m loss, industry demand/pricing is weak, and 2024 free cash after PPE purchase was only about RMB2.184m. Main ranking denominator is therefore the median profit with a 0.40 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: 2024 reported parent net profit is a loss of RMB263.682m and is not used as a standalone sustainable profit base.
Three-year parent net profit sequence: RMB420.072m, RMB106.088m, RMB-263.682m; median RMB106.088m is used as pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit.
FVTPL fair value gain RMB51.772m and bank deposit interest RMB189.080m are not treated as core cement operating profit.
Cement is a cyclical commodity industry; 2024 revenue fell 21% and gross margin fell to 10%.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was positive in 2022-2024, but 2024 operating cash flow of RMB459.738m almost matched PPE purchase of RMB457.554m, leaving only RMB2.184m after PPE purchase.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Latest year loss, cement pricing cycle, reliance on interest/FVTPL items, and weak 2024 post-capex free cash flow justify a 0.40 denominator haircut.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Multi-year operating cash flow is positive, but 2024 free cash after PPE purchase nearly disappeared and working-capital movements distort cash conversion.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: The report does not split maintenance and growth capex; use the 2022-2024 median PPE purchase of RMB359.574m as a maintenance-capex reference.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 operating cash flow included restricted deposit increase, receivable increase and payable increase; no precise normalized working-capital reinvestment amount is available.

limitations: Market capitalization is a rough-screen historical estimate, not independently refreshed in this run.
The annual report does not split cash by listed parent and PRC operating subsidiaries; cash extraction haircut is therefore conservative.
Deposit maturities are disclosed only as over three months, not by full maturity ladder.
2024 is a loss year; sustainable cash-profit denominator is a conservative normalized estimate, not a current-year reported profit.
